eval.title: Is Nike Stock Crash A 2X Opportunity Like Adidas Was in 2022?

call.headline_quote: much better now to buy Nike to conclude but not yet a great value investing opportunity

base_metric.name: net_income
base_metric.quote: let's say Nike's current earnings potential is 5 billion

scenarios.name: worst
scenarios.quote: if I add the p ratio of 10 12 to it then we are at a market capitalization of 50 60 billion

what_is_priced_in.quote: now Nike is still at a p ratio of 20 that is twice what Adidas had when it was hitting rock bottom

reasons.claim: Nike's P/E of 20 is still twice as high as Adidas's P/E of 10 at its bottom, so Nike is not yet as cheap as that comparable opportunity.
reasons.quote: now Nike is still at a p ratio of 20 that is twice what Adidas had when it was hitting rock bottom

reasons.claim: Guidance now shows declining mid-single-digit revenue and profitability after years of flat results, which is why the market re-rated the stock down.
reasons.quote: revenues have flaten for let's say the last year and a half net income already flat over the last few years and now their guidance is for declining revenues thus also declining profitability

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: Nike destroyed value by doing large buybacks at much higher prices, which he sees as a red flag on capital allocation discipline.
reasons.quote: they were spending billions on repurchases at much higher stock prices so that's thrown money

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: Nike's global brand strength means it is unlikely to go out of business and will likely find its way back to growth, similar to Adidas.
reasons.quote: they have this Global Market presence Global brand everyone knows it so they will likely find their ways of grow

reasons.claim: Fashion and consumer preferences are fickle and hard to predict, adding risk to when or if growth returns.
reasons.quote: customer preferences in the fash world are always very very fickle and you never know what these kids will want to buy going forward

external_facts_used: News reports on Nike sales/guidance miss and consumer demand concerns in North America and China
CEO statement that fiscal 2025 will be a transition year with mid-single-digit revenue decline in first half
Analyst estimates from a few months prior projecting continuous EPS growth
Adidas stock history: fell to €99 with P/E of 10 on €2 billion earnings, then rose to €237

critic.notes: He personally passes ('wake me up when 40% down') but says 'you won't lose money long term if you buy now... looks okay' and 'much better now to buy' — a fair_hold, not avoid.
